The datasheet lists available supply voltages of 24 V DC, 115 V AC (50/60 Hz), and 230 V AC (50/60 Hz), with a ±10% voltage tolerance. So 24 V DC will work — you do not need 230 V AC. Note the datasheet says to observe the voltage and current type shown on the valve's type plate for your specific unit, and power consumption depends on size and current type (e.g. for DN 15: 11 VA running / 20 VA inrush on AC, 5 W inrush on DC). The datasheet does not state a current (A) rating for the supply.

gold.answer: Cast iron, WCC or LCC carbon steel, WC9 chrome moly steel, CF8M (cast 316 stainless) or CF3M (cast 316L stainless), others on request. Yes, stainless (CF8M / CF3M) is available.
gold.question: Regarding FV-10-1 on the P&ID: What body materials are available, and can I get stainless for a corrosive service?

candidate: The Fisher ET datasheet lists CF3M (316L stainless steel) and CF8M (316 stainless steel) body/bonnet materials. Stainless options are available, but the excerpts do not state whether they are suitable for corrosive service.
